libraryRootNoteId.label: Library Root
libraryRootNoteId.description: Required. The note that hosts your library: its Database child note holds every tracked title. Selecting it converts that note into a render note showing the tracker; clearing it reverts the previously-chosen note to a text note.

collectionGroups.label: Collection Groups
collectionGroups.description: JSON holding the collection groups and which group each collection belongs to. Managed by the Collections tab.

viewGroupFilters.label: Last Group Filters
viewGroupFilters.description: Remembered per-group Library filters. Managed by the widget, not edited here.

autoSyncStremio.label: Auto-Import From Stremio
autoSyncStremio.description: Run a Stremio import automatically on a schedule. Requires being logged in to Stremio on the Import tab.

autoSyncTrakt.label: Auto-Import From Trakt
autoSyncTrakt.description: Run a Trakt import automatically on a schedule. Requires having authorized Trakt on the Import tab.

autoSyncHours.label: Hours Between Auto-Imports
autoSyncHours.description: Minimum hours to wait between automatic imports. The check runs hourly, so 1 imports every hour and 24 once a day.

autoSyncLastRun.label: Last Auto-Import
autoSyncLastRun.description: Timestamp of the last automatic import. Managed automatically.

autoSyncLastResult.label: Last Auto-Import Result
autoSyncLastResult.description: Outcome of the last automatic import, shown on the Import tab. Managed automatically.

genresEnabled.label: Enable Genres
genresEnabled.description: Show the Genre filter and fetch genres from TMDB. Turn this off to categorise everything with your own collections instead.

hiddenGenres.label: Hidden Genres
hiddenGenres.description: Comma-separated genres to leave out of the Library's genre filter. Managed by the Genres tab.

viewGenreFilter.label: Last Genre Filter
viewGenreFilter.description: Remembered Library view state. Managed by the widget, not edited here.

viewStatusFilter.label: Last Status Filter
viewStatusFilter.description: Remembered Library view state. Managed by the widget, not edited here.

viewTypeFilter.label: Last Type Filter
viewTypeFilter.description: Remembered Library view state. Managed by the widget, not edited here.

viewCollectionFilter.label: Last Collection Filter
viewCollectionFilter.description: Remembered Library view state. Managed by the widget, not edited here.

viewSortKey.label: Last Sort
viewSortKey.description: Remembered Library view state. Managed by the widget, not edited here.

viewSortDesc.label: Last Sort Direction
viewSortDesc.description: Remembered Library view state. Managed by the widget, not edited here.

viewGrouped.label: Last Grouping
viewGrouped.description: Remembered Library view state. Managed by the widget, not edited here.

defaultStatus.label: Status For New Titles
defaultStatus.description: Applied to a title added by hand from search. Imports set status from the source instead.

posterSize.label: Poster Size
posterSize.description: TMDB image width used for poster URLs stored with each title.

tmdbApiKey.label: TMDB API Key
tmdbApiKey.description: Free v3 API key from https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api. Required for search, posters, and episode lists.

traktClientId.label: Trakt Client ID
traktClientId.description: Create an API app at https://trakt.tv/oauth/applications. Use urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob as the redirect URI.

traktClientSecret.label: Trakt Client Secret
traktClientSecret.description: Client secret from the same Trakt API app.

traktAccessToken.label: Access Token
traktAccessToken.description: Filled in automatically after you authorize. Clear it to force re-authorization.

traktRefreshToken.label: Refresh Token
traktRefreshToken.description: Filled in automatically. Used to renew the access token without re-authorizing.

stremioEmail.label: Stremio Email
stremioEmail.description: Login email for your Stremio account.

stremioPassword.label: Stremio Password
stremioPassword.description: Only used to obtain an auth key. Cleared automatically once login succeeds.

stremioAuthKey.label: Stremio Auth Key
stremioAuthKey.description: Filled in automatically after a successful login. Clear it to force re-login.

importMarksWatched.label: Imports Set Watched Status
importMarksWatched.description: An imported title with watch history is marked watched (movies) or watching (shows with unwatched episodes).

importFetchMetadata.label: Fetch TMDB Metadata On Import
importFetchMetadata.description: Look up each newly imported title on TMDB for poster, overview, runtime, and genres. Slower, and needs a TMDB key.

importOverwriteRatings.label: Let Imports Overwrite My Ratings
importOverwriteRatings.description: Off by default so a re-import never clobbers a rating you set in Trilium. Import is one-way; nothing is ever written back to Trakt or Stremio.
